pattern.short_summary: Before acting, the system displays the sequence of actions it intends to take, and that display persists as the actions are carried out.
pattern.definition: Before acting, the system displays the sequence of actions it intends to take, and that display persists as the actions are carried out. The plan is a visible object with its own structure — a diagram, a step list, a lookahead lane — and in several systems it is editable, so the user can alter the plan rather than react to its results. Commitment status may be encoded so the user can tell which parts are still revisable.
pattern.structural_signature: A planning step emits an ordered structure of forthcoming operations that is rendered before any of them executes; execution then advances through that structure while it remains on screen. Where the structure is editable, edits to unexecuted elements change what will run; visual encoding distinguishes executed, committed, and still-provisional elements.

dimension.category_description: How evidence, internals, correspondence, quality, interpretations, and planned actions are represented for human judgment.
dimension.classification_boundary: The representation must support understanding or verification, rather than merely render output into a usable medium.
